svg.text: ESP32-WROOM-32 (30-pin DevKit) + nRF24L01+PA/LNA | TP4056 Type-C charge | 3.7V Li-ion | 2-layer PCB
Designer: Youssif Ahmed Zayed | Business Technology, CIC | Schematic rev A
mounts on 2 × 1×15 PTH female headers (J1 = top row, J2 = bottom row)
TP4056 OUT+ → SW1 → VSYS → ESP32 VIN
ESP32 3V3 (on-board reg out) → nRF24 VCC (+ C1/C2)
All parts PTH except TP4056 module and battery.
